target.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled
target.body:
Related: #55691
Related: #81997

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu users could recall or withdraw a message but OpenClaw would still continue processing that source message and run the agent/tools. This could happen when the recall event arrived while the original message was already debounced, queued, or inside an agent dispatch.

## Why This Change Was Made

Feishu recall handling previously only showed up indirectly at reply delivery time, when sending a reply to a missing/recalled message could fail. This change handles the inbound `im.message.recalled_v1` event at the channel boundary, records the recalled source message in a Feishu-local runtime context, skips recalled messages before dispatch, and binds active dispatches to an abort signal so in-flight runs stop instead of producing replies.

Live testing also showed that some Feishu app configurations may not deliver `im.message.recalled_v1` to the plugin, while Feishu's message reaction API still returns code `231003` (`message not found / maybe deleted`) when the typing target is the recalled source message. The Feishu dispatcher now treats that specific channel-local signal as a conservative fallback only when the missing typing target is the inbound source message, then reuses the same recall registry, abort signal, and reply-suppression path.

The state is process-local and bounded because it only needs to coordinate nearby receive/debounce/dispatch timing within one gateway process. It does not add a core API or persistent storage surface.

## User Impact

When a Feishu user withdraws a message, OpenClaw now treats that source message as cancelled. Pending debounced messages are dropped when the recall event is delivered, active single-agent and broadcast dispatches receive an abort signal, and final replies are suppressed if the recall or missing-source fallback lands before delivery.

## Evidence

AI-assisted change.

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/typing.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/bot.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/monitor.message-handler.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/monitor.reaction.test.ts`
  - 5 files passed, 243 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/feishu/src/typing.ts extensions/feishu/src/typing.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/bot.ts extensions/feishu/src/bot.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
- `node scripts/check-plugin-npm-runtime-builds.mjs --package extensions/feishu`
- `git diff --check`

Live Feishu proof, local gateway with this branch's Feishu plugin dist, 2026-07-08 22:24-22:25 CST:

- `22:24:51 feishu[feishu2]: received message ... (p2p)`
- `22:24:51 feishu[feishu2]: dispatching to agent (session=agent:yuantai:main)`
- User recalled the source message while the agent run was active.
- `22:25:02 Feishu API returned code 231003: message not found / maybe deleted` (message id redacted)
- `22:25:02 feishu[feishu2]: source message missing during typing <redacted> (abortedRuns=1, alreadyRecalled=false)`
- `22:25:02 visible channel turn dispatched with no queued reply payloads ...`
- `22:25:02 feishu[feishu2]: dispatch complete (queuedFinal=false, replies=0)`

Unit coverage also exercises the recall-event path for messages recalled before receive handling, messages recalled during inbound debounce, active dispatch abort, and late reply delivery suppression after a missing/recalled source message.
